adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `hubspotRefreshToken` is assigned from `await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` (line range shown around the change). In sync mode, `refreshOAuthTokens` (new file `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`) performs a `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` and **returns the raw `Response` object** without calling `.json()`. The HubSpot code still types/casts the result as `HubspotToken` and does not parse/validate it, so downstream reads of token fields (e.g., access token / expiry) would be undefined or incorrect when sync mode is enabled.
